title: Printer's Marks in a 3 mm Bleed

metadata.author: pdfnative-cli samples
metadata.subject: Crop marks, registration targets and colour bars in the smallest common bleed — 3 mm, 8.5 pt (pdfnative 1.8.0 marks clearance)
metadata.keywords: print, bleed, crop marks, registration, colour bars, prepress

blocks.text: Three millimetres is the bleed most European printers ask for. It leaves an 8.5 pt strip between the trimmed page and the edge of the sheet — less than the default size of a registration target. pdfnative 1.8.0 re-centres and shrinks the marks to the strip, clamps their stroke to at least 0.5 pt from the MediaBox edge, and drops a registration target altogether below 6.6 pt rather than draw it across the trim.
Compare with 01-bleed-marks.json (9 pt) and 04-colour-bars.json (5 mm, 14.17 pt): the geometry differs, the trimmed page is identical.

cells: the sheet: A4 including the bleed strip

blocks.text: pdfnative inspect prints the boxes of every page; the marks are drawn in the registration colour (the All separation), so they appear on every plate.
